state.question: Which library does this building adjoin, and in which semester did it open?
state.answer: The building in the image adjoins Price Gilbert Library. According to the building record, the G. Wayne Clough Undergraduate Learning Commons opened for the fall 2011 semester. The image shows people inside a large, light-filled space with numerous columns and windows, suggesting a modern library or learning center.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://ce.gatech.edu/node/7514): The G. Wayne Clough Undergraduate Learning Commons opened for the fall 2011 semester. It honors former Georgia Tech president G. Wayne Clough and adjoins Price Gilbert Library. It supports undergraduate learning.
